stability.note: Internal stability on shared in-sample observations; no independent validation or true-class probability.

selection.rule: Within each eom/leaf family retain configurations within 0.02 of maximum assigned coverage; among these prefer highest finite silhouette with at least two clusters, otherwise highest coverage diagnostic outcome. Do not compare this silhouette to full-coverage algorithms without coverage.
selection.cluster_size_note: min_cluster_size limits the number of UIC observations in a density cluster; it does not remove small-electorate precincts.
selection.stability_note: Absolute min_cluster_size and min_samples remain fixed across 80% subsamples; no predictive assignment to excluded UICs is invented.
